description: I’m an old guy.Born in the summer of 1948, I went through my childhood years during the Eisenhower administration. Even though my parents voted for Adlai Stevenson in both the 1952 AND 1956 elections, they liked Ike. His integrity and wisdom earned the respect of just about everyone.
